newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Plan to boost Portugal forestry output.
newsitem.headline: Plan to boost Portugal forestry output.

text.p: The Portuguese pulp industry needs to invest 604 billion escudos over the next decade in new forest management and exploitation techniques in order to boost exports of wood products, a study said.

"The immediate objective will be, via the adoption of new management and exploitation techniques, to raise the volume of wood extracted annually from Portuguese forests by 20 percent without prejudicing its natural development," it said.
The study was carried out by consultants BPI, Agr-Ges and Jaakko Poyry for industrial group Sonae Investimentos, pulp groups Soporcel and Portucel, and the Confederation of Portuguese Farmers (CAP).
